exposure: mode of delivery (C-section vs. home delivery)
cohort: 953 neonates admitted to Medical College of ChiFeng University, China between March 2010 and 2017
finding: The incidence of pneumonia among neonates was 14%, with inadequate prenatal care, home delivery, fever at birth, gynaecological problems during pregnancy, and sustained labor identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was significantly related to neonatal pneumonia (p=0.02).
